vectors.name: ak.vector.encoding.crypto.ed25519_detached_jws.v1
vectors.description: Ed25519 detached JWS over the canonical proof binding object for a Arkret Event Envelope.

test_private_key_jwk.note: Public conformance test key only. Production profiles MUST reject this test DID/key domain.

vectors.name: ak.vector.encoding.crypto.es256_detached_jws.v1
vectors.description: ECDSA P-256 (ES256) detached JWS over the canonical proof binding object for an Arkret Event Envelope. Optional interop suite gated by ak.profile.signature.ecdsa_p256.v1.

test_private_key_jwk.note: Public conformance test key only (d = fixed seed bytes 0x00..0x1f). Production profiles MUST reject this test DID/key domain.

vectors.name: ak.vector.encoding.crypto.mldsa65_raw_detached_signature.v1
vectors.description: ML-DSA-65 (NIST FIPS 204) raw detached signature over the canonical proof binding object bytes (registry proof_kind = raw_detached_signature; no JOSE wrapping). PQC suite gated by ak.profile.signature.pqc.v1.
vectors.keygen_note: Public conformance test key only, generated as an ML-DSA-65 key and recorded with its 32-byte FIPS 204 seed. Production profiles MUST reject this test DID/key domain.
vectors.raw_signing_input: UTF-8 bytes of canonical_binding_payload (detached_payload_b64u is its base64url form, provided for cross-checking only; the signed bytes are the unencoded canonical JSON)
vectors.signature_note: Recorded valid ML-DSA-65 hedged signature over canonical_binding_payload. Verifiers MUST verify the recorded bytes; producers are not required to reproduce the signature byte-for-byte.

negative_cases.name: reject_flipped_signature_bit
negative_cases.description: One bit of the Ed25519 signature is flipped (first signature byte XOR 0x01); everything else is byte-identical to the valid vector.

expected.reason: signature bytes do not verify against the canonical proof binding object

negative_cases.name: reject_alg_none
negative_cases.description: Protected header declares alg=none. The signature segment carries well-formed base64url bytes so the rejection MUST come from the algorithm allowlist, not from shape validation.

expected.reason: alg=none is not an active row of signature-alg-registry.json; critical proofs MUST fail closed before any verification is attempted

negative_cases.name: reject_alg_key_type_mismatch
negative_cases.description: Protected header declares ES256 and the signature genuinely verifies under a P-256 key, but kid resolves to the Ed25519 OKP verification method. The verifier MUST bind alg to the resolved key type (jwk_kty/jwk_crv per signature-alg-registry.json) and fail closed.

expected.reason: declared alg ES256 does not match the resolved verification method key type (OKP/Ed25519); implementations MUST NOT verify with a substituted key

negative_cases.name: reject_truncated_public_key
negative_cases.description: The DID Document publicKeyJwk.x is truncated to 31 bytes; the JWS is the untampered valid vector value.

expected.reason: verification key fails to parse (31 bytes is not an Ed25519 public key length); key material errors MUST fail closed, not fall back to another key

negative_cases.name: reject_non_empty_payload_segment
negative_cases.description: The detached payload is re-attached as the JWS payload segment. The signature still verifies as an attached JWS over the identical signing input, so accepting it would silently downgrade the detached profile; receivers MUST reject on the non-empty payload segment alone.

expected.reason: detached_jws payload segment MUST be empty in compact serialization (encoding.md section 6) even when the attached form would verify

negative_cases.name: reject_es256_truncated_signature
negative_cases.description: The ES256 JOSE signature is 63 bytes instead of the required raw 64-byte r||s form.

expected.reason: ES256 detached JWS signatures MUST be exactly 64 raw bytes (r||s)

negative_cases.name: reject_es256_truncated_public_key
negative_cases.description: The P-256 x coordinate is truncated to 31 bytes while the detached JWS is otherwise valid.

expected.reason: ES256 verification keys MUST contain valid 32-byte P-256 x and y coordinates

negative_cases.name: reject_mldsa65_truncated_signature
negative_cases.description: The ML-DSA-65 raw signature is truncated by one byte.

expected.reason: ML-DSA-65 signatures MUST have the exact FIPS 204 byte length

negative_cases.name: reject_mldsa65_truncated_public_key
negative_cases.description: The ML-DSA-65 public key is truncated by one byte while the signature is otherwise valid.

expected.reason: ML-DSA-65 public keys MUST have the exact FIPS 204 byte length
